articles.title: 李家超：今次五年規劃與施政報告同時諮詢別具意義
articles.summary: 特首李家超話今次五年規劃同施政報告一齊問市民意見好有意義。

levels.text: 特首李家超去咗第一場地區諮詢會，佢話今次五年規劃同施政報告一齊問大家意見，好有意義。佢話五年規劃係香港未來嘅發展方向，而施政報告每年都會講政府點樣做到呢個計劃。佢想市民有咩都講出嚟，唔使分開兩樣意見。今次個會有超過一百三十人去。
levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee went to the first district consultation session. He said it is very meaningful that this time the five-year plan and the Policy Address seek people's opinions together. He said the five-year plan is Hong Kong's future direction of development, while the Policy Address each year talks about how the government will achieve this plan. He wants citizens to say whatever they have to say, without having to separate the two kinds of opinions. Over 130 people attended this session.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席咗香港首場五年規劃同施政報告嘅地區諮詢會。佢開場時話，今次兩樣嘢一齊做諮詢特別有意義。佢話五年規劃係香港嘅發展藍圖，係一份講方向同策略嘅文件，同施政報告係一脈相承。佢又話，施政報告除咗講每年嘅政策，仲係五年規劃嘅年度報告，特首每年都要向社會交代點樣落實個規劃。佢話政府已經收集咗好多意見，希望市民暢所欲言，提意見時唔使刻意分開係規劃定係施政報告。今次個會喺南屯門官立中學舉行，有超過一百三十人出席。
levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee attended Hong Kong's first district consultation session for the five-year plan and Policy Address. In his opening remarks he said it is especially meaningful to consult on both things together this time. He said the five-year plan is Hong Kong's development blueprint, a document about direction and strategy, and it is in line with the Policy Address. He also said the Policy Address, besides covering each year's policies, is also the annual report of the five-year plan, and the Chief Executive must account to society each year on how the plan is being carried out. He said the government has already collected many opinions, and hopes citizens speak freely, without deliberately separating whether their opinions are about the plan or the Policy Address. This session was held at Southern Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, with over 130 people attending.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席香港首場五年規劃及施政報告嘅地區諮詢會，佢喺開場發言時話，今次五年規劃同施政報告一併諮詢特別有意義。佢形容五年規劃係香港嘅發展藍圖，係一份有方向性、宏觀性同策略性嘅指導文件，同施政報告一脈相承。李家超話，施政報告除咗會處理每年嘅政策，仲係五年規劃嘅年度報告，特首每年都要向社會匯報如何落實五年規劃。佢又話政府已經收集咗相當多意見，都同兩者有關，希望市民暢所欲言，提意見時毋須刻意區分係規劃定係施政報告。今次諮詢會喺南屯門官立中學舉行，超過130名人士出席。
levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee attended Hong Kong's first district consultation session for the five-year plan and Policy Address. In his opening remarks he said consulting on the five-year plan and Policy Address together this time is especially meaningful. He described the five-year plan as Hong Kong's development blueprint, a guiding document with direction, a macro view and strategy, in line with the Policy Address. Lee said the Policy Address, besides handling each year's policies, is also the annual report of the five-year plan, and the Chief Executive must report to society each year on how the five-year plan is being implemented. He also said the government has already collected quite a lot of opinions, all related to both, and hopes citizens speak freely, without deliberately distinguishing whether their opinions are about the plan or the Policy Address. This consultation session was held at Southern Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, with over 130 people attending.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席了香港首場五年規劃及施政報告的地區諮詢會。他在開場時說，今次把五年規劃與施政報告一起諮詢，特別有意義。他形容五年規劃是香港的發展藍圖，是一份講方向和策略的文件，與施政報告互相配合。他說施政報告除了講每年的政策，也是五年規劃的年度報告。特首每年都要向社會交代如何落實規劃。他又說政府已收集不少意見，希望市民多發表意見，提意見時不用刻意分開兩者。今次諮詢會在南屯門官立中學舉行，超過130人出席。
levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee attended Hong Kong's first district consultation session for the five-year plan and Policy Address. In his opening he said consulting on the five-year plan and Policy Address together this time is especially meaningful. He described the five-year plan as Hong Kong's development blueprint, a document about direction and strategy, complementing the Policy Address. He said the Policy Address, besides covering each year's policies, is also the annual report of the five-year plan. The Chief Executive must account to society each year on how the plan is carried out. He also said the government has already collected quite a few opinions, and hopes citizens express more opinions, without deliberately separating the two when giving opinions. This consultation session was held at Southern Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, with over 130 people attending.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超出席首場香港首個五年規劃及施政報告地區諮詢會，他在開場發言時表示，今次的五年規劃與施政報告一併諮詢特別具意義。他形容五年規劃是香港的發展藍圖，五年規劃則是方向性、宏觀性、策略性的指導文件，與施政報告是一脈相承。 李家超說，施政報告除了會做每年的政策，更是五年規劃的年度報告，相關概念是五年規劃將香港發展的五年方向宏觀性、策略性地畫龍點睛，行政長官每年的施政報告就要向社會匯報如何落實五年規劃。 李家超說，政府現時已收集相當大量的意見，都是與五年規劃與施政報告有關，希望市民暢所欲言，又說提出意見時，毋須刻意區分五年規劃或施政報告的意見。 今次諮詢會在南屯門官立中學舉行，超過130名人士出席。
levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee attended the first district consultation session for Hong Kong's first five-year plan and Policy Address. In his opening remarks he said consulting on the five-year plan and Policy Address together this time is especially meaningful. He described the five-year plan as Hong Kong's development blueprint; the five-year plan is a guiding document that is directional, macro and strategic, in line with the Policy Address. Lee said the Policy Address, besides setting out each year's policies, is also the annual report of the five-year plan; the related concept is that the five-year plan sketches out Hong Kong's five-year direction of development in a macro and strategic 'finishing-touch' way, and the Chief Executive's annual Policy Address must report to society on how the five-year plan is implemented. Lee said the government has now collected a considerable amount of opinions, all related to the five-year plan and Policy Address, and hopes citizens speak freely, and said that when giving opinions there is no need to deliberately distinguish between opinions on the five-year plan or the Policy Address. This consultation session was held at Southern Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, with over 130 people attending.

articles.summary_en: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee attended the first district consultation session for both the city's five-year plan and the annual Policy Address, held at Southern Tuen Mun Government Secondary School with over 130 attendees.

articles.title: 李家超今早出席地區諮詢會　聽取地區人士意見和建議
articles.summary: 李家超今朝去咗屯門開會，聽街坊講意見。

levels.text: 李家超今朝帶咗好多官員，去屯門開第一場地區諮詢會，聽下街坊嘅意見同建議。個會喺一間中學度開，早上九點幾就陸續有官員到場。李家超話今次會分做細組傾偈，同市民一齊講點樣搞好經濟同民生。市民可以睇電視或者上網睇直播。
levels.text_en: This morning John Lee brought many officials to Tuen Mun to hold the first district consultation session, to hear residents' views and suggestions. The meeting was held in a secondary school, and from a bit after 9 in the morning officials arrived one after another. Lee said this session would be divided into small groups for discussion, talking with the public about how to improve the economy and people's livelihood. People can watch it on TV or online via live broadcast.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超今日帶埋幾位司局長，一齊去出席第一場地區諮詢會，聽街坊嘅意見同建議。呢場會喺南屯門官立中學度開，早上九點幾就陸續有官員到場，包括政務司司長陳國基、財政司司長陳茂波，仲有勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡等等。李家超琴日喺社交媒體話，今次個會會用細組討論嘅形式，同市民傾點樣搞好經濟同民生。市民可以睇電視或者上網睇直播。
levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee today brought along several secretaries and bureau chiefs to attend the first district consultation session, to hear residents' views and suggestions. This session was held at South Tuen Mun Government Secondary School, and from a bit after 9 in the morning officials arrived one after another, including Chief Secretary Eric Chan, Financial Secretary Paul Chan, and Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun, and others. Lee said yesterday on social media that this session would use a small-group discussion format, discussing with the public how to improve the economy and people's livelihood. People can watch it on TV or online via live broadcast.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超今日率領多名司局長，出席首場《香港第一個五年規劃及2026年施政報告地區諮詢會》，聽取地區人士嘅意見同建議。首場諮詢會喺南屯門官立中學舉行，早上九點幾，陸續有問責官員到場，包括政務司司長陳國基及副司長卓永興、財政司司長陳茂波及副司長黃偉綸、勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡、創新科技及工業局局長孫東等。李家超琴日喺社交媒體話，今場地區諮詢會會用小組討論嘅形式，同市民就「拼經濟謀發展」同「惠民生建未來」進行交流；市民可以睇電視或者網上直播。
levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee today led a number of secretaries and bureau chiefs to attend the first "District Consultation Session on Hong Kong's First Five-Year Plan and the 2026 Policy Address," to hear the views and suggestions of local people. The first consultation session was held at South Tuen Mun Government Secondary School. From a bit after 9 in the morning, accountable officials arrived one after another, including Chief Secretary Eric Chan and Deputy Chief Secretary Warner Cheuk, Financial Secretary Paul Chan and Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong, Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun, Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong, and others. Lee said yesterday on social media that this district consultation session would use a small-group discussion format, exchanging views with the public on "striving for the economy to seek development" and "benefiting livelihoods to build the future"; people can watch it on TV or via online live broadcast.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超今日帶領多名司局長，出席第一場地區諮詢會，聽取地區人士的意見和建議。這場諮詢會在南屯門官立中學舉行。早上九時許，陸續有官員到場，包括政務司司長陳國基、副司長卓永興、財政司司長陳茂波、副司長黃偉綸，還有勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡和創新科技及工業局局長孫東等。李家超昨日在社交媒體說，這次會以小組討論的形式進行，與市民交流經濟和民生的議題。市民可以看電視或網上直播。
levels.text_en: Chief Executive John Lee today led a number of secretaries and bureau chiefs to attend the first district consultation session, to hear the views and suggestions of local people. This consultation session was held at South Tuen Mun Government Secondary School. At around 9 in the morning, officials arrived one after another, including Chief Secretary Eric Chan, Deputy Chief Secretary Warner Cheuk, Financial Secretary Paul Chan, Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong, as well as Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun and Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong, and others. Lee said yesterday on social media that this session would be conducted in a small-group discussion format, exchanging views with the public on economic and livelihood topics. People can watch it on TV or via online live broadcast.

levels.text: 行政長官李家超今日率領多名司局長，出席首場《香港第一個五年規劃及2026年施政報告地區諮詢會》，聽取地區人士的意見和建議。 首場諮詢會在南屯門官立中學舉行，早上9時許，陸續有問責官員到場，包括政務司司長陳國基及副司長卓永興、財政司司長陳茂波及副司長黃偉綸、勞工及福利局局長孫玉菡、創新科技及工業局局長孫東等。 李家超昨日在社交媒體表示，今場地區諮詢會會以小組討論形式，與市民就「拼經濟謀發展」及「惠民生建未來」進行交流；市民可收看電視或網上直播。

The first consultation session was held at South Tuen Mun Government Secondary School. At around 9 in the morning, accountable officials arrived one after another, including Chief Secretary Eric Chan and Deputy Chief Secretary Warner Cheuk, Financial Secretary Paul Chan and Deputy Financial Secretary Michael Wong, Secretary for Labour and Welfare Chris Sun, Secretary for Innovation, Technology and Industry Sun Dong, and others. Lee said yesterday on social media that this district consultation session would take a small-group discussion format, exchanging views with the public on "striving for the economy to seek development" and "benefiting livelihoods to build the future"; people can watch it on TV or via online live broadcast.

articles.summary_en: Hong Kong Chief Executive John Lee attended the first of a series of district consultation sessions, held at a secondary school in Tuen Mun, to gather residents' views on the government's upcoming policy plans.
